def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for sr in range(rows):
        for sc in range(cols):
            if grid[sr][sc] == 7 or (sr, sc) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[sr][sc]
            stack = [(sr, sc)]
            seen.add((sr, sc))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop()
                cells.append((r, c))
                for dr, dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    y, x = r+dr, c+dc
                    if 0 <= y < rows and 0 <= x < cols and (y,x) not in seen and grid[y][x] == color:
                        seen.add((y,x)); stack.append((y,x))
            r0 = min(r for r,c in cells); r1 = max(r for r,c in cells)
            c0 = min(c for r,c in cells); c1 = max(c for r,c in cells)
            points = None
            if len(cells) == 4 and r1-r0 == 1 and c1-c0 == 1:
                points = [(r0-1,c0),(r0-1,c1),(r1+1,c0),(r1+1,c1),(r0,c0-1),(r1,c0-1),(r0,c1+1),(r1,c1+1)]
            elif len(cells) == 8 and r1-r0 == 2 and c1-c0 == 2 and grid[r0+1][c0+1] == 7:
                points = [(r0-1,c0),(r0-1,c1),(r1+1,c0),(r1+1,c1),(r0,c0-1),(r1,c0-1),(r0,c1+1),(r1,c1+1)]
            if points:
                for r,c in points:
                    if 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < cols:
                        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
